server.note: Pinned OpenDAoC fork (Offline DAoC 0.35 lineage: server synced to upstream v0.35 d337d18, 0.35 world and navmeshes); macOS port overlay in server/ is applied on top. The ref is verified by git, and the port patches are pre-checked with git apply --check before building.

client.note: Hashes pinned from the release's download-manifest.json; game.dll hash is the pristine v0.35b Sluaghbinder client.

wine.note: athei/wine-build cx-26.3.0-8: CrossOver 26.3 Wine (x86_64, Rosetta 2) with i386 support, the bundled x87sidecar (Rosetta x87 JIT, cooperative attach) and mtld3d (D3D9 on Metal). x87sidecar is what lifts the client from ~7 to 60+ FPS: the game thread is otherwise CPU-bound in Rosetta's x87 emulation. min_macos: its wine, wineserver, ntdll.so and winemac.so carry minos 26.0, so dyld refuses them on older macOS; client install checks it before downloading. Re-check it whenever this pin changes.

wine_arm64.note: Broyojo/hadron v0.2.0: upstream Wine built for arm64 with FEX as its WoW64 (i386) and ARM64EC (x86_64) emulator and mtld3d (D3D9 on Metal). No Rosetta. Its loader (lib/wine/aarch64-unix/wine.app) carries Apple's cross-architecture entitlement from Hadron's provisioning profile, which 32-bit programs need for memory below 4 GB; the runtime is copied out of the disk image unchanged. min_macos: its wine, wineserver, ntdll.so and loader carry minos 27.0, so dyld refuses them on older macOS; client install checks it before downloading. Re-check it whenever this pin changes. daoc runs it with FEX_X87REDUCEDPRECISION=1: with FEX's default full-precision x87 the client holds at ~10-15 FPS in world, with it ~120. Opt-in: daoc client install --wine arm64.

mtld3d.note: Our mtld3d fork (trozzelle/mtld3d branch ppl: upstream athei/mtld3d main at eb1d414 plus the DAoC lighting, fog, water, post-processing and float-scene keys, off unless set in mtld3d.conf), an altered build marked as such. daoc client install puts it into each Wine, saving the Wine's own files under <wine>/.daoc-mtld3d/stock first: rosetta lib/wine/d3d9/mtld3d/{i386-windows,x86_64-windows}/{d3d9,mtld3d}.dll and x86_64-unix/mtld3d.so; arm64 lib/hadron/d3d9/i386/d3d9.dll, lib/hadron/d3d9/markers/syswow64/mtld3d.dll, lib/wine/i386-windows/mtld3d.dll and lib/wine/aarch64-unix/mtld3d.so (then copied into the prefix). daoc client mtld3d stock goes back to the Wine's own; daoc client mtld3d fork returns.

graphics.note: Optional graphical patches the user turns on one by one (retina, srgb, textures, anisotropy). Only daoc graphics pulls it: the first call clones this commit into upstream/graphics/, and every call refuses to run unless HEAD is this commit and git status shows no local changes; daoc client install never fetches it.
